description: This line plot compares the training loss over time for two models: “Vanilla” (purple line with triangle markers) and “SepLLM” (red line with circle markers). The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. Both lines show a general downward trend, indicating decreasing loss over training time. The “Vanilla” line starts at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreases to about 2.50. The “SepLLM” line starts at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreases to about 2.47. A green dashed rectangle highlights the region from approximately 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, where the loss for both models stabilizes near 2.50, and a label “1.26×” indicates that the loss of SepLLM is 1.26 times lower than that of Vanilla at the end of the training period.
